title: The Live Deadline
author: Felix Halloran
blurb: Ulyana Eastwick, a whistle-blower living under four names, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must burn the network that did the training before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
